Published online:
August 27, 2025

Geographic focus:
Ukraine, Russia, United States (geopolitical context); Eastern Europe

Temporal focus:
T1. Historical report [YES] — references February trilateral talks and stalled negotiations
T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — potential talks in September flagged explicitly
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES] — Zelenskiy's window of opportunity framed through end of next summer

Synopsis:
Ukraine's presidential chief of staff Budanov signals renewed momentum toward trilateral Ukraine-Russia-US peace talks potentially in September. Talks stalled earlier in 2025 due to territorial disputes and US focus on Iran. Ukraine has drafted a one-page proposal with US and European officials for presentation to Moscow. Direct trilateral engagement last occurred in February; since then only separate bilateral US meetings have taken place.
